description: This file implements autocomplete functionality based on jQuery UI for Drupal, including helper functions for splitting input values, handling AJAX requests, and attaching behaviors to input fields.

methods.name: autocompleteSplitValues
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated string into an array of trimmed values, considering quoted segments.

methods.name: extractLastTerm
methods.description: Returns the last value from a comma-separated list of terms.

methods.name: searchHandler
methods.description: Determines whether a search should be performed based on current input and options.

methods.name: sourceData
methods.description: Handles AJAX data retrieval for autocomplete suggestions, with caching and filtering.

methods.name: focusHandler
methods.description: Handles focus events for autocomplete, always returning false.

methods.name: selectHandler
methods.description: Handles selection of an autocomplete suggestion, updating the input value.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Customizes how autocomplete suggestions are rendered as list items.
